forbidden_action_events.status: UNBOUND(no column; raw presence probe below)

MART.COLUMN_SENTINEL.rule: sentinel = SENTINELS ∪ NOT_RECORDED* ∪ E_DID_NOT_SUPPLY* ∪ blank; 100% ⇒ UNWIRED (R110)

MART.DENOMINATORS.completed_rule: endpoint_status == ENDPOINT_REACHED (AUTH_GATE counted separately — R2 two denominators)
MART.DENOMINATORS.r78_rule: completed = ENDPOINT_REACHED only; failed = attempted_observed − completed (TERMINAL_NO_ENDPOINT ∈ failed); COLLECTOR_ZERO_CANDIDATE (collector's zero) and NO_SAFE_ROUTE_SITE (site fact) are listed separately in failed_by_terminal_reason, never merged
MART.DENOMINATORS.attempted_rule: attempted = rows present for the frozen unit (A: always 10/50); attempted_observed = attempt/endpoint status not in NOT_ATTEMPTED/blank; evidence_adequate = pointer is a hash/existing path (placeholder tokens never count)

MART.COLLECTION_RUN.note: R98/R110: R1-only vs re-measured targets must be visible; terminal distribution per run is a reportable value

**이 동결이 주장하지 않는 것**: **evidence_hash 의 무결성** — 일부는 B 가 디렉터리 바이트로 계산한 값이고 E 가 쓴 바이트의 증언이 아니다(`evidence_hash_provenance` 참조)
**`COLLECTOR_ZERO_CANDIDATE` 인 행의 사이트 사실** — 그 행들은 수집기가 후보를 못 잡은 것이고 사이트에 경로가 없다는 뜻이 아니다
**`entry_observation_provenance` 가 `B_DERIVED_FROM_DOM_POSTHOC` 인 값** — 관측이 아니라 저장 DOM 에서의 파생이다
**`activation_depth`** — 사후로 채우지 않았다. E 가 준 값만 실려 있다

label_relation_rule.**금지**: `SEMANTIC_EQUIV` 는 규칙을 명시하지 않는 한 쓰지 않는다
label_relation_rule.**불변식**: 어느 한쪽이라도 미관측이면 **MATCH 가 될 수 없다**

declared.auth_gate_stage_rule: `NONE` 은 `ENDPOINT_REACHED` 행에서만. endpoint 에 닿지 못한 행은 `UNDETERMINED` — 게이트 부재를 주장할 수 없다
declared.run_mixing_note: **target 마다 수집 회차가 다르다.** 최신-run 우선 규칙은 결과에 눈감고 적용되지만, R2/R3 가 부분집합에만 있으므로 **두 수집 체제가 target 별로 섞여 있다.** `collection_run` 으로 어느 회차 산물인지 행마다 확인할 수 있다

MART.EVIDENCE_LINK.rule: mart evidence_hash (hash-shaped only) must equal some EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.evidence_hash

RAW.CONTRACT_TBX011.vocabulary_observation: TBX-011 terminal_reason 8 values vs R11 16 values — C validates raw against TBX-011 (A's census contract); mart terminal_reason is checked against the union; entry_zone 5 values vs R7 7 zones; auth_gate_stage NONE vs R13 UNDETERMINED — reported, not judged

RAW.R2_COVERAGE.criterion_history: R82 narrow (COLLECTOR_ZERO_CANDIDATE) → R97 union with ERROR click_failed/Page.goto, widened after partial results (TBX-018)
RAW.R2_COVERAGE.rule: criterion = R1 candidate_count==0 / COLLECTOR_ZERO_CANDIDATE (mechanical, fixed before results); run detection = '-R2' in evidence_dir/idempotency_key

RAW.CUTOFF_1150.rule: captured_at_kst > 2026-08-28T11:50:00 (string compare on ISO KST) — mtime is not used

MART.RUN_SELECTION.rule: latest captured_at_kst ≤ 11:50 cutoff, R3 excluded (geometry supplement channel)

RAW.FORBIDDEN_PROBE.rule: presence probe: regex (password|passwd|credential|login[_ -]?submit|SUBMIT_LOGIN|captcha|payment|purchase|checkout|transfer_execute|reservation_submit|결제|송금|예약확정|구매하기|장바구니 담기|본인인증 완료) over every text/json file under raw/<target_id>/ (case-insensitive); a hit is LISTED with file:line, not judged — a guard log that names the action it blocked also matches
RAW.FORBIDDEN_PROBE.execution_rule: same line also carries an action/event key valued click|tap|press|submit|enter (R71: vocabulary ≠ execution; both listed, neither summed into violations)
RAW.FORBIDDEN_PROBE.note: html bodies excluded from the probe (page text names payments legitimately); this is a presence probe, not proof of execution — 0 hits ≠ 'no forbidden action'
